name: Elephant Sanctuary Morning
tagline: Meet the families who share our forest — at the hour the world is still golden.
description: At first light, accompanied by our resident naturalist, venture to a protected adjacent sanctuary where the Aviora herd gathers to drink and bathe. No riding. No commands. Simply witness these extraordinary beings in their ancient rhythm.

name: Jungle Waterfall Trek
tagline: Follow the stream into the ancient interior — where the forest holds its secrets.
description: A guided trail through primary jungle to a hidden cascade, passing endemic flora and birdlife found nowhere else on earth. Our naturalist guide provides real-time identification and ecological context throughout.

name: Sunset Catamaran Sail
tagline: Chase the horizon as the sky turns gold — champagne optional, extraordinary guaranteed.
description: A private catamaran departs the resort's beach at 17:00, sailing south along the coast. Champagne, chilled seafood and fresh tropical fruit are served as the sun descends. Night bioluminescence swim optional on selected evenings.

name: Ayurvedic Forest Ritual
tagline: Ancient healing rooted in the forest floor — a ritual of complete restoration.
description: Beginning with a private yoga session in the treetop pavilion, followed by a personalised Ayurvedic consultation and a 3-hour sequential treatment: Abhyanga full-body massage, Shirodhara warm oil pour, and herbal steam. Concludes with a meditative tea ceremony.
priceNote: Per person. Booking 48hr in advance required.

name: Private Island Picnic
tagline: A sandbar. Two chairs. The Indian Ocean. Everything you need.
description: A private speedboat transfers you to a secluded sandbar visible only at low tide. A handpicked hamper prepared by The Canopy Table kitchen awaits — chilled wines, artisan cheeses, local delicacies and fresh tropical fruit. Snorkelling gear provided. Return transfer timed to the tide.

name: Cultural Heritage Immersion
tagline: The living culture of the island — told by those who carry it forward.
description: Visit a working cinnamon estate, a traditional mask-carving studio, and a heritage Buddhist temple with a resident scholar-monk. Lunch at a family-run village home, prepared with the produce of their own garden. This journey does not observe culture — it participates in it.
priceNote: Per person. Max 4 guests per departure.
